verdict.rationale: Ramp captures receipts automatically on card swipe with OCR filling memos/categories, and its 99% accuracy OCR extracts line-item detail; submission is possible via SMS, Slack, or Teams (implying photo/forward-style capture) and receipts are auto-matched/coded to the correct transaction and GL account. CLI/receipts endpoints (upload/attach) further confirm receipt-to-transaction matching capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of email-forwarding ingestion and photo-upload mobile app flow specifics, independent user corroboration of OCR accuracy in practice
